newsitem.title: TANZANIA: U.N. tribunal to get hand on key Rwanda suspects.
newsitem.headline: U.N. tribunal to get hand on key Rwanda suspects.

text.p: The international tribunal on Rwanda's genocide has signed a deal with Cameroon for the transfer of four leading suspects held there, a tribunal spokeswoman said on Thursday.

The tribunal had obtained authority to transfer Theoneste Bagosora, a former senior military official, and three others to tribunal headquarters in northern Tanzania, spokeswoman Beatrice Lacoste told reporters ahead of the Thursday trial of another Rwandan Hutu, Jean-Paul Akayesu.
"We have been negotiating with the government of Cameroon to tranfer these four indicted persons to detention in Arusha," said Lacoste.
"The agreement has been signed and they will be transferred to Arusha," she added without giving details.

Twenty-one people have been indicted by the tribunal including Akayesu. Eight suspects are still at large, seven are held in Arusha including Akayesu, four are in detention in Cameroon, and the United States and Switzerland hold one suspect each.
The suspects are accused of crimes committed during the April-June 1994 genocide in Rwanda when an estimated 800,000 Tutsis and moderate Hutus were killed.
